title: Aluminium
notes: ESPR working-plan priority; indicative adoption ~2028-2029 to ~2030. CO2e thresholds in the plugin are indicative pending the delegated act. retentionYears is assumed, not sourced: ESPR Art. 9(2)(i) sets no figure — it requires availability for at least the expected lifetime of the product, delegated per product group, and no aluminium delegated act has been adopted.
